en.executive_summary:

sections.title: THE AETERNAL CALIBRATION & RESOLUTION ENGINE (28-Day Logic Gate)
sections.content:
Our resolution engine operates through a rigid 28-day dual-phase logic gate to dynamically balance textile tension and architectural volume:

* PHASE I: CALIBRATION (Days 1 - 14) - OUTWARD: Focuses on Power & Clarity. Constructs high-tenacity structural shells engineered for high-cognitive-load missions and executive dominance.
* PHASE II: RESOLUTION (Days 15 - 28) - INWARD: Focuses on Repair & Stability. Softens architectural lines to absorb metabolic shifts without compromising sovereign visual authority.

sections.title: THE AETERNAL CALIBRATION & RESOLUTION ENGINE (28-Day Logic Gate)
sections.content:
我們的校準引擎不依賴猜測。它採用嚴格的 28 天雙相位邏輯閘（28-Day Logic Gate），來動態調整織物張力與建築體積，完美重構身體的權力架構。

* PHASE I: CALIBRATION (Days 1 - 14) - OUTWARD：聚焦於力量與清晰度 (Power & Clarity)。構建提供最大支撐力的結構面料，專為高認知負荷任務與社交擴張設計。
* PHASE II: RESOLUTION (Days 15 - 28) - INWARD：聚焦於修復與穩定性 (Repair & Stability)。在不犧牲主權視覺（Sovereign look）的前提下，柔化建築線條，以容納新陳代謝的微幅波動。
